summary: Log bird sightings anywhere and build your life list.
page_description: A field-ready eBird companion for quick sightings, species lookup, life lists, and checklist sharing.
release_notes: Keep species choices and sighting count controls on the screen when text is enlarged.
user: Somebody who watches birds and wants the list to grow.
job: Log a sighting while the bird is still in front of you, and watch your life list grow.
offline: Your sightings live on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: your sightings and the life list built from them
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it is the record the list is counted from

non_goals: It does not identify birds from photos or sound.
It does not share your list anywhere.
